_what: Property tables for the four zooms Builder 2 ported, 2026-09-19. SIZE and POSITION are the SAME TWO DIALS on every one: `scale` is size, `originX`/`originY` is position. Everything past those two is the component's own character.
_contract: Every key here is READ by the built blob and every props.x the blob reads is declared here. ChatCut's validator refuses a mismatch in either direction, and refuses a property read into a binding that is never used.
_correct: `correct` is the rest calibration and arrives as a CSS filter string FROM THE HARNESS at placement. No component contains a level. The value moved 2.0363 -> 1.7228 between two runs of the same arm, so a number written into a blob is right on the day it is written and silently wrong after.
_why: THE FOUR THAT WERE HERE TWICE ARE GONE FROM HERE. DepthPull, FocusWindow, LetterboxPush and SnapReframe were defined in this file AND in the harness, and the loader reported `in_file_won` — the harness copy was the one that took effect, so this copy was already dead and a leg existed only to assert the two agreed. They agreed; nothing made them. The harness is the one place for those four now, and the leg is deleted with the duplicate rather than kept to guard it.
